intro: I take it you're here to service our market of hungry villagers?
Well theres a few things you should know before getting started.
movement: Our town isn't like other towns
While our villagers may be extremely hungry, they're also lazy.
Rather than walking to you, they prefer to be served where they are.
Use the left analog stick to shove that stand of yours right over to 'em.
Try it out with our town training dummy over there!
customers: Great job scraping that thing along!
Now, lets talk about our villagers.
Each villager has their own unique preferences when it comes to food.
When you approach a villager, take a look at the icons above their head to see what they want.
Serve them the right food, and they'll be happy to pay you!
Don't worry about making mistakes though.
If you serve them the wrong food, they'll just immediately want a completely different order.
An important thing to remember is that it takes stamina to prepare and serve food, so make sure you aren't exhausted before taking on a customer.
Try serving our wooden friend here by using the d-pad to fulfill their request.
sprint: In the real market, things can get pretty hectic since there's a lot of competition.
You'll need to be quick on your feet to get to the best customers before anyone else does.
Hold down the A button while moving to sprint and get to those customers faster!
Sprinting with that stand is hard work and will drain your stamina, so be careful not to overdo it.
Try sprinting around a bit now!
bump: Now thats what I call fast!
Let's talk about dealing with other vendors in the market.
Sometimes, other vendors might get in your way or try to steal your customers.
You can give them a bump with your stand to get them out of the way.
Just sprint directly into them to show them whos boss!
Make sure to hit them directly head-on for maximum effect.
You'll feel so good after committing an act of violence that you'll regain a bit of stamina too.
The more momentum you have on impact, the more intensly they'll be lauched.
The more intense the launch, the more stamina you'll recover!
I'd tell ya to try it out, but there doensn't seem to be any other vendors around.
Try it out on this bird instead!
slam: Whoa! Look at that bird fly!
Now, for our another trick: the slam.
Occasionally, you'll find yourself sent flying through the air after a particularly intense bump.
When that happens, you can slam your stand back down onto the ground by pressing the B button while in midair.
The impact of the slam will send out a shockwave that can knock away any nearby competition!
If you time it just right, you can even slam directly onto another vendor for a super powerful bump!
You'll need to wait a moment after being sent airborne to build up enough energy to be able to slam.
As soon as you see your stamina bar flash and hear the ding, you can slam away!
Use this jump pad to launch yourself into the air and try out the slam!
...and don't ask me where I got this jump pad.
parry: Impressive! That was quite the slam.
Now, let's talk about defending yourself.
Sometimes, other vendors might try to bump you out of the way.
If you see one coming, you can use your trusty frying pan to knock them away by pressing the RB button just before they hit you.
The timing is pretty tight, but successfully parrying will not only prevent you from being knocked back, but will redirect their attack back at them!
Busting out your frying pan is risky business.
If you whip it out without successfully parrying an attack, you'll become exhausted and lose all of your stamina.
Make sure to only use it when you really need to!
Use the RB button to try parrying an incoming attack with the from this delicious skewer i'm going to throw at you!
outro: Fantastic! You've got the hang of it now.
With these skills under your belt, you're ready to take on the bustling market and serve our hungry villagers.
Remember to stay quick, keep an eye on your stamina, and don't be afraid to get a little competitive!
Good luck out there, vendor! And make sure that your stand is the last stand standing!
